name: commotion
description: Commotion Agent Operations — Claude Skills that build, configure, deploy, test, evaluate, iteratively improve, and debug voice/chat workers. The skills carry the endpoints and orchestrate the full worker quality loop (create → generate scenarios → run evals → improve), plus a separate production-debug loop (RCA a real call → reproduce it as a failing simulation → fix → verify); a thin Commotion MCP server holds auth (OAuth) and proxies each call, so no API key ever touches the transcript.
